This role offers a rewarding mix of hospital-based and community practice within a team that values collegiality, shared expertise, and high quality service. Our gastroenterologists provide general gastroenterology and hepatology care through a referral-based practice that includes participation in the provincial Colorectal Cancer Screening Program. The group operates with a centralized referral system and a unified EMR (Accuro), which the successful candidate will be welcomed into. Clinical work includes inpatient consultations and participation in the GI on call rotation. The Hepatology/Viral Hepatitis Clinic offers specialized nursing support and FibroScan technology, with optional clinic participation. Interventional radiology services and rotating gastroenterology fellows further enhance the depth of practice. The department benefits from strong working relationships with general surgeons, GPs/hospitalists, and highly skilled RNs, creating a supportive and collegial clinical environment. Teaching opportunities are available through RIH’s affiliation with the UBC Faculty of Medicine, with involvement in training medical students and residents. Apply today to live, work, and play where others only vacation! It's better here! Translate business requirements into scalable system designs and technical solutions. Continuously evaluate available Blue Yonder WMS features and recommend practical process improvements that strengthen warehouse and manufacturing operations. Support system upgrades, enhancements, and production deployments. Develop technical specifications and support documentation. Project Delivery Lead implementation activities through design, build, testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare. Coordinate efforts between business teams, vendors, system integrators, and IT resources. Manage testing, defect resolution, deployment planning, and production support. Provide hands-on support during receiving, warehouse, manufacturing-integration, and outbound operational cutovers. Required Qualifications 7+ years of Blue Yonder implementation experience. Proven experience implementing and configuring Blue Yonder WMS across both inbound and outbound warehouse operations. Experience in manufacturing, warehouse, and distribution environments. Strong understanding of: Inbound receiving, outbound fulfillment, and transportation processes Warehouse execution, including directed put-away, directed work, replenishment, picking, staging, and loading Manufacturing operations and work order integration Inventory management Supply chain processes Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into technical solutions. Experience leading full lifecycle implementations including: Requirements Design Configuration Testing Cutover Hypercare Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Excellent stakeholder communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Multiple end-to-end Blue Yonder WMS implementations across receiving, inventory, warehouse execution, manufacturing integration, and outbound fulfillment. Experience with manufacturing facilities operating in a multi-shift environment. SAP integration experience. Experience integrating Blue Yonder with: ERP platforms MES systems Warehouse automation Transportation systems Blue Yonder certifications preferred. Experience serving as lead consultant or solution architect.

review_candidates.description: Role and Facility Information At Royal Inland Hospital (RIH), you will play a vital role in delivering compassionate, high quality care while working in a collegial and supportive hospitalist practice. As the regional tertiary referral centre for the Thompson Cariboo Shuswap, RIH offers a diverse and engaging clinical environment where hospitalists manage a wide spectrum of conditions, including acute illness, chronic disease, complex geriatric care, and trauma. You will care for patients across the lifespan and serve a richly diverse population, including Indigenous communities and new Canadians, with seasonal and regional variations providing continual clinical interest. You will be supported by an experienced and collaborative hospitalist team, with a strong emphasis on mentorship, comprehensive onboarding, interdisciplinary collaboration, and ongoing professional development to help you thrive in your role. The scheduling model at RIH is designed to support flexibility and long term sustainability. Full time hospitalists work 24 weeks per year, averaging 72 hours per week, with each week consisting of six day shifts, one 12 hour late shift to midnight (on site until 11 p.m.), and one 8 hour overnight home call. For a 1.0 FTE, this averages one extended late shift and one overnight call every two weeks, with call frequency adjustable based on individual preference. All hours worked between 11 p.m. and 8 a.m. are eligible for MOCAP Level 2. Part time opportunities are also welcomed and supported. RIH places a strong value on lifelong learning and academic involvement. Hospitalists participate in interdisciplinary rounds, supported CME, and conferences, and have opportunities to teach family practice residents, UBC third year clerks, and fourth year visiting students.
